limitations: No specific visible Dreams artifact or frame-rate improvement has been attributed to this correction.
Tests execute production MarkAsMaybeDirty and RefreshImage plus native GPU image upload/readback; page ownership and source-buffer delivery use bounded fixture adapters.
Coverage includes linear RGBA8, BC1 and BC3, one/three mips, one/two layers, unchanged adjacent accesses, late/prefix writes and combined CPU/GPU invalidation.
OS page faults, detiling and multisample behavior are not newly certified; no new performance claim is made.
The clean executable retains tested production objects and omits five diagnostic objects; it was not separately played.
